Class RegionDescriptor

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.RegionDescriptor
public class RegionDescriptor extends Object
The RegionDescriptor is a copy of one region's layout for a caller to read. The hot page is the page that currently receives new frames. The object stores the region id and the hot page id. The object stores the hot page capacity in bytes. The object stores the used bytes on the hot page. The object stores the spilled-byte count the caller passed. The object stores the message count. The object stores whether the region is pinned. The object stores the page flags. A caller reads these values and does not change the region through this object. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RegionDescriptor roux-design.md

  • Constructor Details

    • RegionDescriptor

      public RegionDescriptor(String regionId, int hotPageId, long capacityBytes, long usedBytesHot, long usedBytesSpilled, long messageCount, boolean pinned, int flags)
      The constructor stores the layout values for one region.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      hotPageId - The hot page id is the page that currently receives new frames.
      capacityBytes - The capacity is the hot page size in bytes.
      usedBytesHot - The used count is the bytes already written on the hot page.
      usedBytesSpilled - The spilled count is the bytes recorded as spilled.
      messageCount - The message count is the number of frames in the index.
      pinned - The flag is true when the region is pinned.
      flags - The flags are the page flag bits.
